fact.content: The test-runner wrapper (.claude/skills/test-runner/scripts/run_command.py) requires a request file's basename (minus .json) to exactly equal the JSON body's own command_id field -- both an embedded dot (e.g. 'V-1.resume2') and a basename/body mismatch (e.g. filename 'V-1-resume2' with body command_id 'V-1') are rejected (rejection_category identifier_invalid / request_path_identifier_mismatch respectively) before any real command runs. Confirmed live in run-20260917-logicrepair-002 with two real command_rejected responses.
